report.scope: Structural/Git verification only. No target code or tests are executed.

metadata.body:
Adds Microsoft SQL Server to Java JDBC conformance for the OpenTelemetry Java agent and JDBC library instrumentation. Coverage includes statements, prepared statements, batches, and stored procedures.

The database runner starts a digest-pinned SQL Server 2025 CU8 Developer container, initializes its schema, and classifies spans as `db.sql_server.client`. Backend-specific SQL actions and telemetry expectations now live together in shared contracts consumed by the JDBC scenarios, while the PostgreSQL and MariaDB workloads remain unchanged.
metadata.title: Add Microsoft SQL Server JDBC conformance
